summary: The PR adds `startswith` and `endswith` methods to `Query` in `tinydb/queries.py`, matching the issue requirements exactly. Both methods guard with `isinstance(value, str)` so missing fields, `None`, and numbers return `False` without raising, and matching is case-sensitive. The new test file `tests/test_autose_strings.py` covers all five acceptance criteria and passes, and the full existing test suite also passes.

checks.evidence: tests/test_autose_strings.py::test_ac3_nonstring_start and test_ac4_nonstring_end passed; snippet confirmed None/123/{} do not match
